text.text_excerpt: This place is about 5 aisles of a regular supermarket that i've been to. But they do have a good selection of food, but all in small quantities. Perfect for myself. It's easy to find, lots of parking out front, even though i don't have a car. The groceries are a bit pricier than what i'm used to, but maybe because it's a small New Orleans grocery store, versus the prices i'm used to paying in California. I'll definitely be back to get more groceries.

The Uptown area would not be as quaint & sweet without this affordable little mainstay of a neighborhood grocery store. I hold a special place in my heart for Langenstein's. I trust the store with their great fresh meat/fish selections. For those people who don't cook, a large prepared foods section can be found here. A hot bar has recently been added, as well. For a small store, I think that many of their prices are competitive with Winn-Dixie & Rouses, while boasting a variety of grocery options, plenty of staff to handle demand, & a good bit of available parking spaces. Whether shopping for the week or just picking up 1 item to complete a recipe, I always have a positive experience at ...

The prepared foods here are four and five stars all the way while the grocery selection is more of a three star limited selection at higher prices. The location is next to the Jewish Cemetery and its an old fashioned style smaller market with a decent assortment of produce and nice collection of local New Orleans foods. The butcher and meat department really does some excellent work and this is great place to get your carnivorous needs cared for. This place definitely has a lot of unique NOLA charm to it that you just won't find at many other larger stores.
